reuse.why: Uses rschedule occurrences and d.isWeekend, but bolts the daily rule inline into getNextDate instead of extending the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper that the other weekend paths call.

duplication.why: The condition isDaily && skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend is repeated three times inside getNextDate, and the occurrence-fetch call is duplicated in a new loop.

placement.why: Change sits in shared/schedules.ts, the right module, but in one consumer function rather than in the shared weekend-handling helper.

scope.why: Focused on getNextDate plus one test; no unrelated edits, though it misses the other code paths the request implies.

maintainability.why: Inline loop with a magic 366 bound, triple-repeated predicate, and the rule now diverges between getNextDate and the upcoming-dates preview and template paths that still move weekend dates.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts encodes the daily rule inline and bypasses getDateWithSkippedWeekend, which server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts keep using unchanged

disguised_duplication.where: The repetition is literal (same predicate thrice, same occurrences call), not disguised.

one_place.where: Rule lands only in getNextDate; getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and schedule-template.ts still call getDateWithSkippedWeekend and move daily weekend occurrences.
